code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and relative neutropenia and lymphopenia, with elevated erythrocyte count and mild monocytosis, eosinophilia, and basophilia. Glucose is slightly low. Liver and kidney function, electrolytes, and proteins are within normal limits. Findings suggest possible underlying hematologic or respiratory disorder; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
